answer: Send an onyx writ: every new identity faces one audit in its first three epochs, at a random epoch, and gets a writ naming three established auditors who re-contact its attesters and re-check the work before it closes. A fake that fails loses its identity and its $25 onyx deposit, paying the auditors; a split verdict spirals it to five auditors, and a confirmed failure ripples outward to its vouching agents. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 fake histories and bribing 5,000 attesters $10 each to lie on re-contact, $50,000 in bribes alone, no bulk rate; an honest agent posts $25 once.
